title: Cascading Smoothers for Multigrid
summary: Multigrid methods are among the most effective frameworks for solving large-scale sparse systems. However, achieving their hallmark linear scaling and rapid convergence crucially depends on an effective smoother algorithm, whose design is often highly problem-dependent. This paper develops a new approach, referred to as \textit{cascading smoothers} due to their operation as an ordered sequence of single-step block-diagonal smoothers.
